tool_input.command: git remote -v; which glab; ls .xping; env | grep -i -c 'PAYMENTS_SANDBOX\|GITLAB'
tool_input.description: Check remote, GitLab CLI and local sandbox config

result:
- **Cause:** The payment sandbox was briefly slow, not this MR. The same `PaymentTimeoutException` hit this test three times between 09:21 and 09:22 across two runners. Two of those were on `main` (32f21f2), which doesn't have the idempotency change. Every later run in the history passed, including `main` on runner-02 at 09:23. The one run of 55ec951 on my side also passed (17 ms).

- **Action:** I changed nothing. The code isn't at fault, and raising the 2 s timeout or adding a retry would only mask a provider blip. The pipeline is not green yet: the `test` job on MR !41 needs a retry, and I couldn't trigger it because this clone has no git remote.

`CarrierClient_ReturnsQuote_FromSandbox` has failed on `main`'s last two runs with `HttpRequestException` (and on `feature/carrier-bearer-token`), so the retry may go red on that test instead. It passed in the one run of this commit, so I didn't dig into it.
